description: This file defines a class ContactsJjwg_MapsLogicHook which implements logic hook functions for a SugarCRM module related to contact geocoding information. It contains methods to update geocode info before saving a contact and after saving a contact to related meetings.

classes.name: ContactsJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: A class implementing logic hooks for geocode update operations specific to the Contacts module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class by loading the jjwg_Maps module information.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Called before saving a contact to update geocode information if logic hooks are enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Called after saving a contact to update geocode info for related meetings if logic hooks are enabled.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode information for a contact before save if enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for meetings related to a contact after save.
